page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m2s.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 4 physical cores with 4 vCPUs, providing a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 2.0 GB per core. For accelerated workloads, the instance features a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU allocation of approximately 0.0833 of a physical GPU, which provides 2 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core scoring 1884.98 and PassMark CPU scoring 8818.51. However, multi-core scaling is limited, as evidenced by a weak stress-ng multi-core score of 5733.3 and a poor multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 21.75 GB/sec. Memory performance is mixed; while cached read-only small block bandwidth is average at 421.08 GB/sec, the PassMark memory score is poor at 1096.88. For specialized tasks, the instance achieves average performance in small-model LLM inference, processing 414.01 tokens per second for a 135M model, but drops to a poor 4.57 tokens per second for text generation on a larger 7B model.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the fractional GPU allocation allows users to access hardware acceleration capabilities without the expense of a full GPU. This resource density makes the instance suitable for lightweight graphical tasks, virtual workstations, or small-scale machine learning inference. However, the lack of local storage and the poor multi-threaded performance present clear tradeoffs, limiting its utility for data-intensive or highly parallelized computing. Appropriate workloads include lightweight GPU-accelerated applications, static web serving, and basic single-threaded processing tasks.
